title: Net Nation
style: afro jazz, female lead vocal, live drums and horns, 92 BPM, call and response, world music pickleball anthem, uplifting choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
One net. One rule.
Keep it low. Keep it in.

[VERSE 1 - English]
At the net the game is won
Low and soft, that's how it's done
Two steps up, hold your ground
Best position on the court is found

[VERSE 2 - Zulu transliteration]
Enethi umdlalo uwuwile
Phansi futhi kahle, yilokho okwenziwa
Izinyathelo ezimbili phambili, ma uzinze
Indawo engcono enkotini ithiwe

[VERSE 3 - Vietnamese transliteration]
O luoi, tro choi duoc chien thang
Nhe va thap, day la cach lam
Hai buoc len, giu vi tri cua ban
Vi tri tot nhat tren san da tim thay

[CHORUS]
NET - INETHI - LUOI - NETZ
LOW AND SOFT - HOLD YOUR GROUND
NET NATION - EVERY COURT
TWO STEPS UP - HOLD THE LINE

[VERSE 4 - Romanian]
La fileu jocul se castiga
Jos si usor, asa se face
Doi pasi inainte, tine-ti pozitia
Cea mai buna pozitie pe teren e gasita

[VERSE 5 - Punjabi transliteration]
Net te khel jittiya jaanda
Naram te nivaana, eihi tarika
Do kadam aage, apni jagah pakad
Maildan de vich sabh to changi jagah labhi

[VERSE 6 - Icelandic]
Vid netid er leikurinn unninn
Laegt og blidt, svona er gert
Tvo skref fram, haltu stodu
Bestu staedid a vellinum fundid

[CHORUS]
NET - INETHI - LUOI - NETZ
LOW AND SOFT - HOLD YOUR GROUND
NET NATION - EVERY COURT
TWO STEPS UP - HOLD THE LINE

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
From Zulu to Icelandic.
From Punjabi to Vietnamese.
Same net. Same truth.
Two steps up. Hold the line.

[FINAL CHORUS]
NET - INETHI - LUOI - NETZ
LOW AND SOFT - HOLD YOUR GROUND
NET NATION - EVERY COURT
TWO STEPS UP - HOLD THE LINE
ONE NET - EVERY NATION
HOLD THE LINE - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
One net. Every nation.
Hold your ground.
